findings.current_candidate_limit: Exact current derived hooks were independently inspected and contain no nested calls. No extra environment step or RNG draw was observed from those exact hooks.
findings.minimal_fix: Validate exact inserted hook AST against a versioned whitelist, including argument expressions and count/order, before inverse projection; reject these two negative cases.
findings.observed: Projection removes observer call expressions without validating their arguments; extra env.step/RNG in such arguments is accepted by the projection.

findings.current_candidate_limit: Ordinary filesystem writing was not shown to mutate real simulator state. The original anomaly cause is not inferred.
findings.minimal_fix: Recheck passive_environment after final write alongside the existing object/global-RNG checks; fail-stop on mismatch and retain the failed event. Add this negative case.
findings.observed: Simulator/environment RNG equality is checked before the final journal write only; a synthetic journal-write callback can change the fake simulator while the record still declares passive_sim_and_environment_rng_unchanged=true and the observer continues.

findings.current_candidate_limit: No automatic GPU retry exists in this package and none was run. A future outer runner still must stop on any observer exception; the current internal dead/no-retry guarantee is incomplete.
findings.minimal_fix: Include initial guard collection inside the same fail-stop boundary and retain an abort record when possible; add reader-failure/no-retry negatives for all three initial guard calls.
findings.observed: Errors in initial global_rng/object_guard/passive_environment occur outside the fail-stop try block. A synthetic RNG reader error was not journaled or latched; the same object accepted an explicit later CPU capture.
